query: Key contributions and follow-ups of 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017)
highlights: The paper introduces the Transformer architecture which relies solely on attention mechanisms without recurrent or convolutional layers [1, p.3, Fig.1:].
Scaled dot-product attention mechanism is a key component of the Transformer, allowing it to focus on relevant parts of input data [1, p.4, Fig.2:].
Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces, improving its performance [1, p.4, Fig.2:].
The Transformer model achieves higher BLEU scores compared to previous state-of-the-art models on English-to-German and English-to-French translations [1, p.8].
The Transformer architecture reduces training costs significantly while maintaining high accuracy [1, p.8].
